planSteps.description: Navigate to the app root at http://localhost:5173/
Open the ROOMS tab or the Multiplayer Rooms panel
Verify the panel shows the PUBLIC ARENA active channel and a CREATE PRIVATE ROOM button
Verify a private room is created, the active channel changes to a room code, and COPY INVITE plus PUBLIC controls appear
Click PUBLIC to leave the private room
Verify the active channel returns to the Global Public Arena
